title: AidOS landing: directions from your reference
question: Three directions built from the 'Prepared' reference: dark atmospheric hero, centred sans headline with an italic serif accent, pill CTAs, the product peeking below. Pick one, or steer.

options.label: Night Terrain
options.thesis: The reference's night atmosphere becomes a dark topographic map of a fictional region, with the demo scenario's depot and zones pinned on it.
options.viewport: Framed hero over a contour map; centred headline with 'every decision counts.' in italic serif; white and dark pill CTAs; the dashboard window rises from the bottom edge.
options.risk: Contour lines must stay quiet, or the map competes with the headline.

options.label: Aurora Ridge
options.thesis: Closest to the reference: a night sky with aurora light over a mountain ridge, a faint grid, and the dashboard emerging from the ridge line.
options.viewport: Rounded framed hero with sky and aurora; centred headline and pills; the mountain ridge cuts across, and the product window sits in front of it.
options.risk: The most familiar of the three: atmosphere carries the look more than anything specific to AidOS.

options.label: Ops Horizon
options.thesis: Same dark world, bolder composition: a left-aligned headline over a wide terrain band, with live scenario panels (stock against requests) floating on the right.
options.viewport: Headline left over the dark terrain; a stack of three scenario panels at right showing medical, water and shelter stock against requests; CTA pills under the headline.
options.risk: Close to the split-hero template if the panels look like generic cards.
